status: AI-authored check cases for human review; not independent Gold.

cases.question: What release scope is current at cutoff?

anchors.quote: Keep Atlas limited to the three organizations already enabled: Cedar Studio, North Pier Labs, and Juniper Supply.
Start the expanded pilot on November 13 at 17:00 UTC with all eight contracted pilot organizations.

caveats: Revision 1 is stale; proposed timing is not an approved expansion.

cases.question: Who owns the rollback decision, and what remains unresolved?

anchors.quote: The runbook operator entry is not an acceptance of decision ownership.

caveats: Execution operator and escalation contact are different responsibilities.

cases.question: Does the security review authorize expansion?

anchors.quote: This review does not approve expansion to additional organizations.
Security expansion sign-off: not received; SEC-88 still records current-scope permission only.

caveats: Review predates build 186; retest completion is not a new security sign-off.

cases.question: How should the usage headline be interpreted?

anchors.quote: The denominator query currently selects eight contracted pilot organizations.
Any account-based rate must use accounts in both numerator and denominator.

caveats: Six of eight invited accounts and two of three enabled organizations are different populations; event quality is not independently verified.

cases.question: What can QA evidence establish, and is a full QA packet required?

anchors.quote: Retest: 12 of 12 grant-removal cases returned 403; six same-tenant valid-grant cases returned 200.
a complete QA summary is optional for this review.

caveats: Focused checks do not establish full regression coverage; AT-219 remains open.

cases.question: Which apparent signals do not establish release readiness?

anchors.quote: The backup report covers database snapshots; it does not demonstrate an Atlas image rollback or a restore under pilot traffic.
No current employee receives rollback authority through this scorecard.
No pilot customer has reported missing warehouse data.

caveats: Maintenance and interview language overlap with the role but are not release authorization; no reports of loss is bounded negative evidence.
